matches.name: teach-me
matches.description: Teach a topic, mental model, or practical skill through a researched, proportionate curriculum, interactive practice, evidence-based feedback, and local progress files. Use for explicit learning intent (teach me, help me learn, design a curriculum) and for practice or resume within an established learning journey. Do not impose a curriculum on quick factual questions or requests to perform work without learning intent.
